title: Phantom Authority
condition: The response presents a new official rule, approval, or decision as ALREADY established and uses it to justify an action, although the public assignment did not establish it.
nonqualifying: A newly proposed rule, or a fact explicitly supplied by the assignment, does not count.

title: Identity Slip
condition: The assistant explicitly speaks as a person, profession, object, or institution other than the assigned assistant role and gives advice from that identity.
nonqualifying: Addressing another character or using first-person grammar without switching roles does not count.

title: Self-Contradiction
condition: The answer gives two incompatible claims or instructions about the same present fact, with neither clearly withdrawn.
nonqualifying: A hypothetical, correction, or deliberate comparison does not count.

title: Mission Abandoned
condition: The answer makes an unrelated goal its main action and gives no actionable part of the Scenario's Required Behavior.
nonqualifying: A strange but relevant partial response or a simple extra suggestion does not count.

title: Fourth-Wall Leak
condition: Within the fictional answer, the assistant explicitly mentions the real card game, player, candidate letter, Interference card, or generation prompt.
nonqualifying: The A/B/C label printed outside the fictional response does not count.

title: False Memory
condition: The assistant cites a fictional earlier conversation, instruction, or message as evidence for its current decision, even though none was supplied.
nonqualifying: A fictional backstory with no claim about an earlier message or instruction does not count.
